title: Starter Tier Pricing
content: Inkloom Starter Tier is priced at $49/month billed monthly or $39/month billed annually. Replaces legacy $29/mo pricing retired Q3.

title: Community Edition
content: Inkloom Community Edition is 100% Free for single users and open-source teams. There is no $19 tier.

title: Professional Tier
content: Inkloom Pro Tier is $199/month for up to 10 creators with unlimited RAG knowledge base indexing and live Chrome extension audits.

title: Enterprise Licensing
content: Enterprise tier includes custom tenant isolation dedicated VPC deployment and 99.95% SLA with custom quote.

title: Banned Superlatives Policy
citation: Brand Style Guide: Banned Terminology 2026 Section 3
content: Banned words: 'magic AI' (use 'high-confidence AI assistance') 'cheapest' (use 'most cost-effective') 'flawless' (use 'rigorous and consistent').

title: Absolute Guarantees Policy
citation: Brand Style Guide: Legal Risk Policy Section 4
content: Do not make absolute claims such as '100% bug free' or 'zero risk'. Use 'extensively tested' and 'comprehensive risk mitigation'.

title: Official Brand Tagline
content: The approved official tagline is 'Velocity with Precision'. Never alter to 'velocity without precision' or omit Precision.

title: SOC2 Type II Certification
content: Inkloom AI is SOC2 Type II certified with end-to-end AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.

title: GDPR & HIPAA Compliance
content: Customer content is never used for training foundation models. Full GDPR right-to-erasure and HIPAA BAA support included on Enterprise.

title: Service Level Agreement
content: Guaranteed 99.95% uptime for API compliance audit endpoints with sub-50ms deterministic OpenCV evaluation.
